resources.string: Can\'t reach your server right now
Signed out by the server. Sign in again.
VoidBridge isn\'t running. Open the app to start it.
Use your VoidBridge server account, or a sync code with no server. Use the same one on all your devices.
Invite code (only to create an account)
Your password also encrypts your clipboard, so the server can\'t read it.
or join devices that already have one:
A sync code has 16 letters and digits, like ABCD-EFGH-2345-WXYZ.
Enter this sync code on your other devices to add them:
Devices on the same network find each other automatically. With a server, this keeps sync working at home even if the server is down.
Easiest: on your PC, open VoidBridge → Phone setup, plug in this phone, and click “Set up this phone”. It does steps 2–4 for you.
1. Notifications: required to keep syncing in the background.
2. Unrestricted battery: stops Android from cutting the connection while the screen is off.
3. Display over other apps: lets VoidBridge read what you copy without you opening it.
4. Automatic phone → other devices needs one permission that only a computer can grant. Use Phone setup on your PC, or run this with adb:
4. Automatic sync from this phone is on. (On Android 13+, tap “Allow” if asked about device logs.)
4. Automatic sync from this phone works out of the box on this Android version.

Copies from your other devices always arrive automatically. To send from this phone without step 4, use the “Send clipboard” Quick Settings tile, the notification button, or Share → “Send to all my devices”.
